key_line.detail: Q4 economic fuel $4.65-4.85/gal (~$650m above initial plan); FY26 adjusted EPS -5.50 to -5.00, implying a Q4 loss of about -2.1 to -2.6 per share; street FY26 was about -3.47 on stockanalysis as of 2026-10-19 (per the stage E-P hunt, may be stale). Q4 unit revenue up low double digits, capacity +1-1.5%, CASMex up mid single digits.

guidance.detail: First FY26 EPS guide since the April suspension, set at a deep loss on fuel; revenue/yield guide firm (Q4 unit revenue up low double digits, demand 'healthy').

call.detail: Conference call is today at 11:30 ET, inside the session. Management message in the release is 'demand remains healthy', yield strength continuing; the call is a two-sided event risk for a position held past the open.

public_reaction.summary: No post-release analyst actions or press coverage of the reaction found in two searches before 09:20 ET.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 34.00 vs prev close 34.36 (-1.05%), after hours -0.32%, pre-market range 33.90-34.51, 85 prints, 17 in the last 30 min, last at 09:14, not stale. Far inside the 8.9% implied move and below my -5% release read; after a whole night the market reads the guide as largely expected (the street FY bar was likely already lower than the stale -3.47), so I weight the tape over my bar estimate. Market up ~0.3%.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was fuel overrun and a loss guide at >$4.25 fuel: the Q4 fuel guide is $4.65-4.85 and FY is a deep loss. Peer-style fare pass-through (unit revenue +12%, Sept yield +17%) is the offset the judges named, and the tape suggests it is carrying weight.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market at a small -1% gap, so the open should land near it; a small gap gives little fade pressure, and the 11:30 call is the main source of later movement in either direction.

recommendation.reason: De jaarprognose is een groot verlies door dure brandstof, maar na een hele nacht daalt het aandeel voorbeurs maar ongeveer 1%: de markt had dit grotendeels verwacht. Het gesprek met beleggers is pas om 11:30 en kan beide kanten op; dek de short bij de opening en neem de kleine winst, zoals de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs voor 09:30 wegzakt onder 33,90 met doorlopende handel, is de markt de prognose alsnog aan het verwerken en is vasthouden tot het slot het overwegen waard.
